name: toon
description: On Codex, learns the signatures of JSON-emitting Bash commands into a shared registry that sharpens TOON detection on other hosts. Codex's hook contract supports neither the pre-tool command rewrite nor the post-tool output replacement the plugin uses elsewhere, so no TOON conversion happens on Codex itself (the ~40-60% token savings apply on Claude Code).

interface.shortDescription: On Codex, learns JSON-emitting Bash command signatures into a shared registry (TOON conversion itself runs on Claude Code, not Codex).
capabilities: Learns JSON-emitting command signatures into a shared registry, sharpening TOON detection on other hosts
